content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I can’t remember my password and need to reset it.
No problem! Please go to the account recovery page by clicking the link in your email titled 'Reset Your Password'.
Okay, I’ve opened the password reset page. It’s asking for my username.
Great. Please enter your username—usually your employee email, like john.doe@company.com—and then click 'Next'.
I’ve entered my email and pressed Next. Now it wants a verification code.
You should have received a 6-digit code in your inbox. Please enter that code in the field provided.
Got it. I entered the code, and it’s asking me to create a new password.
Perfect! Choose a strong new password, enter it twice to confirm, and then click the 'Submit' button to complete the reset.
I’ve set my new password. It says my account is updated.
You’re all set! Try logging in with your new password now. Let me know if you need anything else.
